application.why_mentor: I broke into data science without a CS degree and spent years feeling like I did not belong. I know exactly what it feels like to sit in a room and wonder if you are the only one who does not know what they are doing. I mentor because representation and guidance matter — especially for women and first-gen professionals in technical fields.
application.previous_experience: Mentored 4 mentees over 2 years through a Women in Data Science program. Two landed their first data roles within 6 months.
application.expectations: A mentee who is curious, coachable, and willing to do the work between sessions. I give honest feedback and I expect openness to receive it.
application.additional_context: I am a first-generation Indian-American who navigated the pressure of family expectations while building a career I actually love. I understand that journey deeply.
